features.name: Shadowed Grit
features.text: When you succeed on an Action Roll with Fear, you can spend a Hope to clear a Stress.

features.name: Veilwalker
features.text: You can briefly slip into the realm between the living and the dead. Mark a Stress to move up to Close range through creatures and objects.

features.name: Veilstalker
features.text: When you use your Veilwalker feature, you can now move to a location within Far range, and you have advantage on the next action roll you make in this scene.

features.name: Horror Honed
features.text: You cannot be made Vulnerable unless all your Stress is marked.

features.name: Spectral Form
features.text: Once per long rest, when you would mark your last Hit Point, you can mark a Stress and enter your Spectral Form instead. While in this form, you can move through physical matter and have resistance to physical damage. Additionally, when you would mark a Hit Point, you mark a Stress instead. You drop out of this form if your last Stress is marked or you clear a Hit Point.
